name: Rule-family variants
description: Lexical variants that complete the rule families in data/rules/families.json: reworded versions of patterns other packs catch literally. Few and high-value by design; the family guidance, not a list of strings, is what tells a rewrite that paraphrasing a pattern does not remove it.

rules.name: Comparative contrast framing
rules.description: A contrast between two comparatives set up to sound decisive (smarter, not harder).

remediation.guidance: Say what to do and why, without the contrast.

rules.falsePositiveNotes: Literal comparisons of two measured things ('faster, not slower, than last year') are rare but possible.

rules.name: Paired negations
rules.description: Two negated labels set against a positive one (not a trend and not a fad).

remediation.guidance: Say what it is. Denying labels nobody applied is filler.

rules.falsePositiveNotes: Genuine exclusions ('not red and not blue') match too; they are uncommon in prose.

problematic: This is a movement, not a trend and not a fad.

rules.name: Unsourced authority (variants)
rules.description: Authority invoked without a source, in forms the weasel-attribution list does not name (experts confirm, studies prove).

remediation.guidance: Name the source, or state the claim on its own evidence.

rules.falsePositiveNotes: Fine when a named source follows; this rule cannot see citations.

preferred: A 2024 Forrester survey of 300 teams found the approach cut review time.

rules.name: Importance signalling (variants)
rules.description: Phrases that assert importance or decisiveness instead of showing it (proving the value of, is what determines).

remediation.guidance: State the fact that shows the importance, or cut the sentence.

problematic: The results prove the value of a strong culture.
preferred: Teams with weekly retros shipped 20% fewer regressions.

rules.name: Generic optimization clichés
rules.description: Stock productivity phrases that could describe anything (work smarter, unlock potential, move the needle).

remediation.guidance: Replace with the specific change and its effect.

problematic: The platform unlocks every member's potential.
preferred: The platform lets anyone on the team deploy.
